the same article 
Same article also presents an 1890–1895 East Coast Scotland static model with 
identical 25-group topology. It is an extracted unselected candidate, distinct from 
the selected 1991–1995 parameterization. Historical data do not support multistanza 
groups. 1890s canonical model | Source review 
Selection rationale 
User previously preferred this exact model for the least SPPR failures. GE and With 
Egestion are OK; TE FAIL persists. Model choice remains provisional for whole-region 
geographic transfer and accepted source/runtime differences. 
Model extraction 
Main PDF, four-sheet Table S 1–S 4 workbook and methods DOCX are retained. 
Existing audit matched 97 printed core parameters,232 source diet cells and 775 
roundtrip values. Canonical parameters preserved; accepted diet normalization, GS 
defaults and residual BA completion are documented. Source Turbot/Ling balance is 
indeterminate without BA; computational balance is a separate finding.

Geographic fit 
Approximate A:37–42% of the target region is covered by the study. B:99–100% of 
the study is inside the region. Different denominators; source-map/land-mask 
sensitivity brackets, not statistical intervals. Geographic assessment 
Temporal fit 
Static 1991–1995 ecosystem coefficients are applied across catch years 1950–2019. 
The 2019 reference is 24–28 years later. Fixed biomass/catch composition proxies do 
not reconstruct annual ecosystem change; publication 2025 does not make the 
historical model contemporary. 
Other 
With Egestion: no negative SPPR entries across all 78 cells; rho_living=0.16967174; 
b=0.09714913; Detritus SPPR=1.20948850; overall OK. Source excludes discards, 
whereas regional total catch includes them. Reconstructed/defaulted runtime 
fidelity and geographic transfer remain limited; no scientific parameter repair made.

Taxon mapping and coverage 
Reference:2019 total catch; all catch labels, including zero catch and unidentified categories; no group filter. 
25 source ecological groups (+1 computational import);384 catch labels. 
Independent simple-chain PPR totals 188,909,420.83 t C; total catch 2,717,260.70 t. 
72 labels lack a saved classic coefficient/TL; all have zero 2019 total catch and therefore zero annual PPR. 
Unavailable TL remains ?, not zero. 
Method: saved classic wet-weight coefficient × total catch /9 once. Model-mapping coverage and classic-PPR 
confidence shares are different measures.

Each rule table uses the same complete classic-PPR denominator, once per taxon. Multi-group splits use 1991–
1995 landings shares only when every candidate has genuine source catch. Missing Infauna/Large zooplankton 
source catches trigger complete biomass fallback. Historical Scottish composition is assumed for the wider 
region, all years and total catch including discards. Weights and rejected catch attempts 
Very low: 110 labels, 12.0072% of catch and 3.8483% of classic PPR. Broad marine fish/invertebrate labels and 
unlisted reef, bathyal, diadromous or taxonomically distant forms use explicit approximate pools/analogues. 
Unresolved:12 freshwater labels, 0.0023% catch and 0.0034% PPR: Carassius carassius, Cyprinidae, Cyprinus 
carpio, Esox lucius, Hypophthalmichthys nobilis, Leuciscus idus, Lota lota, Perca fluviatilis, Rutilus rutilus, Sander 
lucioperca, Scardinius erythrophthalmus and Tinca tinca. No meaningful marine analogue was established. 
Coverage does not establish ecological validity. Separately, Marine fishes not identified contributes 12.49% of 
GE,12.36% of TE and 12.22% of With Egestion model PPR. These are method-specific shares, not the classic-PPR 
percentages above. Method contribution review
